newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,9-,12-mo up, 6-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,9-,12-mo up, 6-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, nine-month, 12-month treasury bills edged up, and six-month T-bill yields slipped from the most recent sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills rose to 24.47 percent from 24.24 percent, six-month bills slipped to 30.26 from 30.29 percent, nine-month bills edged up to 33.01 percent from 32.99 percent, and 12-month bills rose to 38.05 from 37.62 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill
auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 2.30 million UAH 1.14 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.17 million UAH 1.07 million UAH
The central bank sold 23,017 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 9,200 were competitive and 13,817 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 2.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 10.59 million UAH 1.41 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.20 million UAH 1.23 million UAH
The central bank sold 105,905 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 97,563 were competitive and 8,342 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 2.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.27 million UAH 2.18 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.02 million UAH 1.75 million UAH
The central bank sold 12,694 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 11,000 were competitive and 1,694 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 2.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 2.38 million UAH 18.14 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.73 million UAH 13.19 million UAH
The central bank sold 23,812 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 23,345 were competitive and 467 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 2.
